data.one_liner: In-app network inspector for Dio, http, and custom requests with redaction, edit & replay, and exports.
data.what_it_does: Captures HTTP network traffic, logs requests and responses, and provides an in-app dashboard for inspection, editing, and replaying API calls. It also includes an optional performance monitor, file explorer, and cloud syncing.
use_when: You need to inspect HTTP traffic directly inside your Flutter app without a proxy setup.
You want to allow QA and developers to review network requests, performance metrics, and app sandbox files.
avoid_when: You need a production-grade file explorer enabled for end-users.
You require zero external local storage footprint for logs.
strengths: Automatic capture for Dio and package:http via optional companion packages
Built-in data redaction for sensitive headers and body keys
Export options including HAR 1.2, Postman Collection, JSON, and cURL
weaknesses: Stores unencrypted logs locally in Hive which could expose sensitive data if redaction is misconfigured
Requires separate companion packages for Dio or http integration
data.setup_notes: Call ApiStudio.initialize() in main and add the appropriate client interceptor or wrapper package.
